title: Dynamic Instance Switching in 5G Network Slices Based on Load
summary: IIT Hyderabad is implementing dynamic switching of network-slice instances to respond to changing load.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The proposed network-management approach adjusts slice instances as conditions change. Implementation is in progress and no testbed result is supplied. Improved resilience and support for smart-city services are intended applications.
purpose: Adapt network resources to changing demand.
system: Dynamic Instance Switching in 5G Network Slices Based on Load

ratings.reason: Dynamic 5G slice switching is still being implemented and has no testbed result.
Reliable smart-city services are a prospective application.
